schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-xwiki-xhtml-printer-raw-html-macro-close
title: XHTML printer printRaw passes raw content to super without escaping the {{/html}} macro terminator
summary: An XHTMLWikiPrinter-style printRaw override forwards raw content straight to the parent printer.
  Raw content, or raw content combined with adjacent plain text, can contain "{{/html}}" and so close
  the surrounding HTML macro early. Everything after that point is parsed as wiki syntax, which allows
  injection of arbitrary macros and leads to XSS or code execution.
cwe:
- CWE-74
- CWE-79
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 92bc8095ed3acce15ab200c8525e1623b4898be5
  vulnerable_ref: 92bc8095ed3acce15ab200c8525e1623b4898be5^
  patched_ref: 92bc8095ed3acce15ab200c8525e1623b4898be5
  repository: https://github.com/xwiki/xwiki-rendering
rule:
  message: 'printRaw forwards raw content to super.printRaw without escaping "{{/html}}" (or its trailing
    prefixes). Attacker-controlled content can close the HTML macro and inject wiki syntax.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "public void printRaw(String $RAW)\n{\n  ...\n  super.printRaw($RAW);\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "public void printRaw(String $RAW)\n{\n  ...\n  $RAW.replace(\"{{/html}}\", ...);\n\
      \  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Before delegating to the parent printRaw, replace every "{{/html}}" in the raw content with
    an escaped form such as "{{/html}}". Also escape any prefix of "{{/html}}" at the end of
    the content, so that raw content and following text cannot be combined to form the terminator. Pass
    the escaped string to super.printRaw.
  example: "@Override\npublic void printRaw(String raw)\n{\n    handleSpaceWhenStartElement();\n    String\
    \ escapedRaw = raw.replace(\"{{/html}}\", \"{{/html}}\");\n    // also escape a trailing\
    \ prefix of {{/html}}\n    super.printRaw(escapedRaw);\n    this.elementEnded = true;\n}\n"
